_note: Concept domains of the archive. Each organization is filed under exactly one domain. Edit freely; generate.py reads this file. Optional per domain: name (the dotted concept name) and reference (the organizations that define the concept, each with its role), roles (the other organizations in the domain, each with its role) and descriptions (the map's own one-line description for an organization whose GitHub description is empty or only a motto; the GitHub description stays on its map page) and logos (an organization's official logo: src, the image the map shows; svg, its source; branding, its branding guide).

domains.title: Communication
domains.name: blockchain.communication
domains.concept: Token, talk and transaction: wallet-to-wallet messaging and blockchain communication systems, where a message is trusted because its signature verifies.

reference.chatter3: the forum: signature-verified conversation for people and agents, built to cypherpunk4096 with cryptoAGI agents as participants; research into XMTP, WalletConnect sign-in, libp2p and mesh transport
reference.chattchain: the chain: messages and identity carried on chain; research into on-chain conversation (conversation-contract), the XMTP node (xmtpd), ERC-1056 DIDs (ethr-did-registry), encrypted ERC-20 memos (recibo), Internet Computer canisters (motoko) and Arweave hosting (ar-io-deploy)

roles.web3comm: the environment: Token · Talk · Transaction, everything a wallet needs to talk to another wallet; research into ENS names, sign-in and key infrastructure (Web3Auth, SIWE), Lit Protocol gated access, XMTP messaging, the Cryptoverse line (tokntalk, ethmail.cc, calleth.me), Telegram/XMPP/Twitter bridges, value in the message (DeChat, Unlock) and agent skills
roles.blktalk: the systems layer: wallet-signature communication and what it stands on; research into Proof (zero knowledge: zk-kit, privacy-ethereum), Place (IPC subnets: consensus-shipyard), Passage (AggLayer and zkEVM bridges), Person (did:ethr, UNS, sign-in), plus XMTP, Lit Protocol and dyne.org social wallets
roles.blockwhisper: the continuation: the record of blockchain.communication across chatter3, chattchain, web3comm and blktalk, and the next work; named for Whisper, the messaging protocol of the original web3 trio
